name: Till Paradise Do Us Part
source:
A short re-telling of Sarawakian folklore "Kusau and Dayang Menterik" in visual novel format.

[from [url=https://c-ppucino.itch.io/till-paradise-do-us-part]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以視覺小說形式，簡短重述砂拉越民間傳說《庫紹與達央．門特里克》。

[摘自[url=https://c-ppucino.itch.io/till-paradise-do-us-part]itch.io[/url]]
